intro: Merit-based fellowship of CHF 10,000 per semester for outstanding master’s students at EPFL, with a reserved student room for external candidates. Tuition and rent are not covered.
description:
Overview

EPFL offers a limited number of Master Excellence Fellowships to outstanding students beginning a master’s degree at EPFL in Lausanne, Switzerland. Selection is merit-based and also considers extracurricular distinction in sport, arts, civic life or entrepreneurship. External candidates with a bachelor’s degree from another institution are eligible, as are EPFL bachelor’s graduates continuing at EPFL.

The fellowship provides substantial financial support and the reservation of a student room, but it is not fully funded: tuition fees and rent remain payable by the student.

Fellowship Value and Duration

EPFL Master Excellence Fellowship benefits
ItemDetails
Fellowship amountCHF 10,000 per semester for up to four semesters — up to CHF 30,000 for a 90 ECTS master’s or CHF 40,000 for a 120 ECTS master’s.
HousingA room in a student residence is reserved for external candidates. This is a reservation benefit — rent is not covered and must be paid by the student.
Certificate of ExcellenceAwarded at the end of the master’s programme.
Not coveredTuition fees (about CHF 780 per semester, or CHF 2,240 at the tripled rate for students who moved to Switzerland for education), rent, food, transport, health insurance and other living costs.
RenewalFor the second year you must earn at least 50 ECTS and maintain an overall average of 5.0/6.

Eligibility

  • External candidates of any nationality who have obtained a bachelor’s degree at another institution, or EPFL bachelor’s graduates beginning a master’s at EPFL.
  • Remarkable academic results, plus distinction in extracurricular activities (research, publications, prizes, entrepreneurship, societal commitment, arts or sport).
  • You must apply for an EPFL master’s programme and tick the excellence-fellowship box on the application form.
  • IELTS/TOEFL is not specifically required for the fellowship, but EPFL master’s admission requirements apply separately — check them for your programme.

Application Deadlines

2027 fellowship deadlines
ItemDetails
External candidates15 December 2026 — the application must be paid for and validated by this date to be eligible for the fellowship.
EPFL students applying for a consecutive master’s31 January 2027.
General master’s application second window31 March 2027 — applications after 15 December may still be reviewed for admission but are not eligible for the Excellence Fellowship.
Reference lettersUp to one week after the application deadline, as specified by EPFL.

How to Apply

  • Submit the EPFL master’s application online, tick the box requesting consideration for the Excellence Fellowship, and provide the requested file.
  • Pay the application fee (CHF 150 for foreign bachelor’s degree holders) and validate the application before 15 December 2026.
  • The fellowship is awarded together with the admission decision. Internal candidates continuing in the same field submit directly to their section.
  • Apply through the official EPFL Master Excellence Fellowships page.

Official Link

EPFL — Master Excellence Fellowships

Important Notes

  • Guaranteed housing is valuable in Lausanne’s competitive accommodation market, but the room is not free.
  • The 15 December 2026 deadline is strict for fellowship eligibility — the later 31 March admission deadline does not preserve fellowship eligibility.
  • Bring enough funds for initial expenses: the first fellowship payment may take time to reach a Swiss bank or postal account.
